pages.text: A Murdergleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a yellow-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an asscher cut.$(br2)When toggled on, a Murdergleam guarantees that all of your attacks will be critical hits. Each attack drains a point of charge (even attacks that deal no damage due to attacking too

quickly). The gem can be toggled on or off by left clicking.$(br2)When a Murdergleam runs out of charge, it automatically toggles itself off. Likewise, when it reaches full charge, it automatically toggles itself on.$(br2)To recharge a dun Murdergleam, land traditional critical hits while the gem is toggled off.

$(bold)Gemcutter recipe$()$(br2)1 × arcanearchives:shaped_quartz$(br)4 × minecraft:yellow_dye$(br)1 × minecraft:diamond_sword$(br)2 × minecraft:blaze_powder$(br2)Output: 1 × arcanearchives:murdergleam
